verdict.rationale: Name.com has building blocks for background automation: webhook subscriptions for real-time domain and account events such as transfer status changes, renewals and compliance notices, plus registrar-side auto-renew. These pair with a full Core API, SDKs and an MCP server for agents. However, there is no first-party way to define and run autonomous automations; users must host their own webhook consumers or agents to act on events. Missing for 10: a native automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring task execution, agents that run autonomously in the background on Name.com's side, and independent corroboration.
